_comment: Saliency materializer batch manifest for BVI-DVC D-tier (ADR-0993).
_status: BLOCKED — the BVI-DVC feature parquet (runs/full_features_bvi_dvc_D_refresh_20260520.parquet) uses a 'key' column with encode identifiers (e.g. 'DAdvertisingMassagesBangkokVidevo_480x272_25fps_10bit_420'), not file paths. No width/height columns are present.
_resolution: Option A (recommended): Use the raw YUV reference files directly.
Source YUVs are in .corpus/bvi-dvc-raw/ with naming convention
Generate a BVI-DVC corpus JSONL by running:
(or adapt the existing script to emit a src+width+height JSONL for the raw YUVs).
The raw YUV geometry is encoded in the filename: e.g. 3840x2176.
For saliency the reference (not distorted) clips are appropriate.
Option B: Add a path-enrichment step to bvi_dvc_to_full_features.py to
emit an absolute 'src' column pointing to the MKV encode, then re-run
Note: raw YUV sources require explicit -f rawvideo -video_size WxH -pix_fmt yuv420p
flags in ffmpeg — these are already handled by materialize_saliency_features.py
(see PR #540 / ADR-0993) when source extension is .yuv and default_width/default_height
